crossRefs.note: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their…
